method: javap -c -p of mapped Minecraft 1.8.9 classes plus existing session 13 decompiled source inspection
findings: GlassBlock.getRenderLayer returns CUTOUT; StainedGlassBlock.getRenderLayer returns TRANSLUCENT.
WorldRenderer.setWorld -> reload chooses active GLX backend, releases/recreates chunk storage, switches chunk factories/lists and rebuilds sky when backend changes.
Both backends iterate chunks in supplied order. Display lists capture geometry during upload; VBOs bind each layer buffer and set per-buffer attribute pointers before drawing.
Translucent layer schedules up to 15 resort tasks when camera displacement squared exceeds 1; worker sorting and uploads are asynchronous.
Minecraft.stop only clears running, so the current runGame call can still tick/render; final harness restores prior VBO with vanilla reload after export.
